```{r, fitting-SEM-DAGs, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # model 3
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c1", start = 0.25),
      list(p = "B",             label = "c2", start = 0.5),
      list(p = "prop_del_sites",label = "c3", start = -0.25)
    ),
    B = list(
      list(p = "prop_del_sites",label = "c4", start = -0.25),
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c5", start = -0.25),
      list(p = "avg_rec",       label = "c6", start = 0.25)
    ),
    avg_mut = list(
      list(p = "avg_rec",       label = "c7", start = 0.25)
    ),
    avg_rec = list(),
    prop_del_sites = list()
  )
  
  # Covariances
  covs <- list()
  
  # Defined combinations (named character vector)
  defined <- c(
    mu_B_pi      = "c1*c5",
    rec_B_pi     = "c2*c6",
    rec_mu_pi    = "c1*c7",
    rec_mu_B_pi  = "c2*c5*c7"
  )

  model3_constrained <- make_lavaan_model(edges,
                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,
                                          groups = 22,
                                          free_by = "groups",
                                          label_prefix = "x")
  
  model3_constrained <- paste0(model3_constrained, "\n", "avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites")

  m3_gw <- sem(model3_constrained,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="regressions",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  model_free_with_group_defs <- paste0(model_free_with_group_defs, "\n", "avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites")

  m3_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,    
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m3_gw, m3_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {
    # lavTestLRT returns a matrix/data.frame; coerce to data.table for fwrite
    df <- as.data.table(lrt_res, keep.rownames = "comparison")
    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "comparison")
    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
      xn <- as.numeric(x)
      if (all(is.na(xn)) && is.character(x)) return(x) else return(xn)
    }), .SDcols = num_cols]
    fwrite(df, out_path)
    message("Wrote lavTestLRT results to: ", out_path)
  } else {
    # Fallback: AIC/BIC and sample-size-adjusted comparisons
    aic_free <- AIC(m3_chr); aic_constr <- AIC(m3_gw)
    bic_free <- BIC(m3_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m3_gw)
    df_free  <- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_chr, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    df_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_gw, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_free<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_chr, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_gw, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
  
    fallback_df <- data.table(
      comparison = c("free", "constrained"),
      AIC = c(aic_free, aic_constr),
      BIC = c(bic_free, bic_constr),
      df  = c(df_free, df_constr),
      nobs = c(nobs_free, nobs_constr)
    )
    fwrite(fallback_df, out_path)
    message("lavTestLRT failed; wrote AIC/BIC fallback to: ", out_path)
  }
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3_chr, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3_chr, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_chr, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_chr)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_chr))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # model 4
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c1", start = 0.25),
      list(p = "B",             label = "c2", start = 0.5),
      list(p = "prop_del_sites",label = "c3", start = -0.25)
    ),
    B = list(
      list(p = "prop_del_sites",label = "c4", start = -0.25),
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c5", start = -0.25),
      list(p = "avg_rec",       label = "c6", start = 0.25)
    ),
    avg_mut = list(
      list(p = "avg_rec",       label = "c7", start = 0.25)
    ),
    avg_rec = list(),
    prop_del_sites = list()
  )
  
  # Covariances
  covs <- list(
    c("avg_mut", "prop_del_sites")
  )
  
  # Defined combinations (named character vector)
  defined <- c(
    mu_B_pi      = "c1*c5",
    rec_B_pi     = "c2*c6",
    rec_mu_pi    = "c1*c7",
    rec_mu_B_pi  = "c2*c5*c7"
  )

  model4_constrained <- make_lavaan_model(edges,
                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,
                                          groups = 22,
                                          free_by = "groups",
                                          label_prefix = "x")
  
  m4_gw <- sem(model4_constrained,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="regressions",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m4_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m4_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  m4_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,    
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m4_gw, m4_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG4_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {
    # lavTestLRT returns a matrix/data.frame; coerce to data.table for fwrite
    df <- as.data.table(lrt_res, keep.rownames = "comparison")
    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "comparison")
    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
      xn <- as.numeric(x)
      if (all(is.na(xn)) && is.character(x)) return(x) else return(xn)
    }), .SDcols = num_cols]
    fwrite(df, out_path)
    message("Wrote lavTestLRT results to: ", out_path)
  } else {
    # Fallback: AIC/BIC and sample-size-adjusted comparisons
    aic_free <- AIC(m4_chr); aic_constr <- AIC(m4_gw)
    bic_free <- BIC(m4_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m4_gw)
    df_free  <- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_chr, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    df_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_gw, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_free<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_chr, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_gw, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
  
    fallback_df <- data.table(
      comparison = c("free", "constrained"),
      AIC = c(aic_free, aic_constr),
      BIC = c(bic_free, bic_constr),
      df  = c(df_free, df_constr),
      nobs = c(nobs_free, nobs_constr)
    )
    fwrite(fallback_df, out_path)
    message("lavTestLRT failed; wrote AIC/BIC fallback to: ", out_path)
  }
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m4_chr, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m4_chr, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_chr, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_chr)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_chr))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # one model per chrom
  for(c in 1:22) {
  
    data <- filter(table_1Mb_g, chrom==c) %>%
      dplyr::select(., avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
    n <- ncol(data)
    
    cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
    colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
    
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
        cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
        p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      }
    }
    
    combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        if (i > j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
        } else if (i < j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
        }
        # Diagonal remains NA
      }
    }
    
    combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
    rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)
    fwrite(combined_mat, paste("real_data_maps/pearson_chr", c, "_", m, "_1Mb.csv", sep=""),
           row.names=T, quote=F)
    
    model_1 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
    "
    
    m1_fit <- sem(model_1,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m1_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_2 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    "
    
    m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m2_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_3 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m3_fit <- sem(model_3,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m3_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_fit)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_fit))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    model_4 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m4_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m4_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_fit)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_fit))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m3_fit, m4_fit),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_DAG4_1Mb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  }
}

# bootstrapping chr 22 to test if the high R^2 is due to sampling low drift-variance windows
nboot <- 1e3
c22 <- filter(dt, chrom==c)
c22_r2_m1 <- numeric(length=nboot)
c22_r2_m2 <- numeric(length=nboot)
c22_r2_m3 <- numeric(length=nboot)
c22_r2_m4 <- numeric(length=nboot)

for(b in 1:1000) {
  
  cat(paste("boot", b, "\n"))
  
  c22_boot <- c22 %>% dplyr::slice_sample(prop=1, replace=TRUE)
  
  m1_fit <- sem(model_1,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m1[b] <- inspect(m1_fit, "r2")[1]
  
  m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m2[b] <- inspect(m2_fit, "r2")[1]
  
  m3_fit <- sem(model_3,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m3[b] <- inspect(m3_fit, "r2")[1]

  m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m4[b] <- inspect(m4_fit, "r2")[1]
}

c22_boot_r2 <- cbind.data.frame(c22_r2_m1, c22_r2_m2, c22_r2_m3, c22_r2_m4)
names(c22_boot_r2) <- paste("model", 1:4, sep="_")

c22_boot_r2$boot <- 1:nrow(c22_boot_r2)
c22_boot_r2_m <- pivot_longer(c22_boot_r2, cols=starts_with("model"), names_to="model", values_to="r-sqrd")

b <- ggplot(c22_boot_r2_m, aes(x = model, y = `r-sqrd`)) +
geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.6) +
labs(
  x = "Model",
  y = "Bootstrapped R²",

save_plot("real_data_maps/boot_r2_chr22.pdf", b)
```

Fitting models with prop_del_sites scaled by their mean s

```{r, fitting-SEM-DAGs, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

split_sds <- fread("real_data_maps/func_split_scaled_delsites.csv.gz")
phast_sds <- fread("real_data_maps/phastcons_scaled_delsites.csv.gz")

scaled_del_sites <- rbind.data.frame(split_sds, phast_sds)

df_10kb <- scaled_del_sites %>% filter(., scale==1e4) %>% 
                                left_join(., human_maps_10kb,
                                                       by=c("chrom",
                                                       "chromStart",
                                                       "chromEnd",
                                                       "constrained_model"))

# 10 kb
for(m in unique(df_10kb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("10kb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_10kb <- filter(df_10kb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_10kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_10kb$avg_pi)
  
  # replace prop_del_sites by its weighted measure
  if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$scaled_del_sites_masked) 
  } else {
    tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$scaled_del_sites_masked) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_10kb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                            "chromStart", 
                                            "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, rec_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, mut_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                     "chromStart", 
                                                     "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- filter(tbl_10kb, coverage >= 0.75)
  names(tbl_10kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")

  table_10kb_g <- add_genome_offsets_and_midpoint(tbl_10kb, chrom_lengths=NULL)
  
  data <- dplyr::select(table_10kb_g, avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
  n <- ncol(data)
  
  cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
  colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
      cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
      p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
    }
  }
  
  combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      if (i > j) {
        combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
      } else if (i < j) {
        combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
      }
    }
  }
  combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
  rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)
  fwrite(combined_mat, paste("real_data_maps/pearson_gw_10kb", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         row.names=T, quote=F)
  
  dt <- copy(table_10kb_g) %>%
        arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
        as.data.table()
  setDT(dt)
  
  # genome-wide models, DAGs 1-3 (DAG 4 will be tested per chr)
  # model 1
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut", label = "c1", start = 0.25),
      list(p = "B",       label = "c2", start = 0.5)
    ),
    B = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut", label = "c3", start = -0.25)
    )
  )

  covs <- list()
  
  defined <- c(
    direct_mut_pi   = "c1",            # avg_mut -> avg_pi (direct)
    indirect_mut_pi = "c3*c2",         # avg_mut -> B -> avg_pi (indirect)
    total_mut_pi    = "c1 + c3*c2",    # total effect of avg_mut on avg_pi
    direct_B_pi     = "c2"             # direct effect of B on avg_pi
  )
  
  model1_constrained <- make_lavaan_model(edges,
                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,
                                          groups = 22,
                                          free_by = "groups",
                                          label_prefix = "x")
  
  out <- preprocess_sem_from_lavaan(model1_constrained, 
                                  df = dt,
                                  taper_radius = 5e5,
                                  pos = "midpoint",
                                  chrom = "chrom") 
  full_df <- out$full_df
  sem_df_std <- out$sem_df_std
  sem_df_std$chrom <- full_df$chrom
  sem_df_std$chrom <- as.factor(sem_df_std$chrom)
  
  m1_gw <- sem(model1_constrained,
                data       = sem_df_std,         
                estimator  = "MLR",              
                missing    = "fiml",             
                meanstructure = FALSE,            
                std.ov     = TRUE,
                fixed.x    = FALSE,
                optim.method = "nlminb",         ,
                group="chrom",
                group.equal="regressions",
                control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  summary(m1_gw, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
  inspect(m1_gw, "coef")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_gw, ci=T),

               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  out <- preprocess_sem_from_lavaan(model_free_with_group_defs,

                                  taper_radius = 5e5,
                                  pos = "midpoint",
                                  chrom = "chrom") 
  full_df <- out$full_df
  sem_df_std <- out$sem_df_std
  sem_df_std$chrom <- full_df$chrom
  sem_df_std$chrom <- as.factor(sem_df_std$chrom)

  } else {
    # Fallback: AIC/BIC and sample-size-adjusted comparisons
    aic_free <- AIC(m3_chr); aic_constr <- AIC(m3_gw)
    bic_free <- BIC(m3_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m3_gw)
    df_free  <- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_chr, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    df_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_gw, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_free<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_chr, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_gw, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
  
    fallback_df <- data.table(
      comparison = c("free", "constrained"),
      AIC = c(aic_free, aic_constr),
      BIC = c(bic_free, bic_constr),
      df  = c(df_free, df_constr),
      nobs = c(nobs_free, nobs_constr)
    )
    fwrite(fallback_df, out_path)
    message("lavTestLRT failed; wrote AIC/BIC fallback to: ", out_path)
  }
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3_chr, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3_chr, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_chr, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_chr)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_chr))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # model 4
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c1", start = 0.25),
      list(p = "B",             label = "c2", start = 0.5),
      list(p = "prop_del_sites",label = "c3", start = -0.25)
    ),
    B = list(
      list(p = "prop_del_sites",label = "c4", start = -0.25),
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c5", start = -0.25),
      list(p = "avg_rec",       label = "c6", start = 0.25)
    ),
    avg_mut = list(
      list(p = "avg_rec",       label = "c7", start = 0.25)
    ),
    avg_rec = list(),
    prop_del_sites = list()
  )
  
  # Covariances
  covs <- list(
    c("avg_mut", "prop_del_sites")
  )
  
  # Defined combinations (named character vector)
  defined <- c(
    mu_B_pi      = "c1*c5",
    rec_B_pi     = "c2*c6",
    rec_mu_pi    = "c1*c7",
    rec_mu_B_pi  = "c2*c5*c7"
  )

  model4_constrained <- make_lavaan_model(edges,
                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,
                                          groups = 22,
                                          free_by = "groups",
                                          label_prefix = "x")
  
  out <- preprocess_sem_from_lavaan(model4_constrained, 
                                  df = dt,
                                  taper_radius = 5e5,
                                  pos = "midpoint",
                                  chrom = "chrom") 
  full_df <- out$full_df
  sem_df_std <- out$sem_df_std
  sem_df_std$chrom <- full_df$chrom
  sem_df_std$chrom <- as.factor(sem_df_std$chrom)
  
  m4_gw <- sem(model4_constrained,
                 data       = sem_df_std,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="regressions",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m4_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m4_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )
  
  out <- preprocess_sem_from_lavaan(model_free_with_group_defs, 
                                  df = dt,
                                  taper_radius = 5e5,
                                  pos = "midpoint",
                                  chrom = "chrom") 
  full_df <- out$full_df
  sem_df_std <- out$sem_df_std
  sem_df_std$chrom <- full_df$chrom
  sem_df_std$chrom <- as.factor(sem_df_std$chrom)

  m4_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = sem_df_std,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,    
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m4_gw, m4_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG4_gw-equal-freechrom_10kb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {
    # lavTestLRT returns a matrix/data.frame; coerce to data.table for fwrite
    df <- as.data.table(lrt_res, keep.rownames = "comparison")
    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "comparison")
    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
      xn <- as.numeric(x)
      if (all(is.na(xn)) && is.character(x)) return(x) else return(xn)
    }), .SDcols = num_cols]
    fwrite(df, out_path)
    message("Wrote lavTestLRT results to: ", out_path)
  } else {
    # Fallback: AIC/BIC and sample-size-adjusted comparisons
    aic_free <- AIC(m4_chr); aic_constr <- AIC(m4_gw)
    bic_free <- BIC(m4_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m4_gw)
    df_free  <- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_chr, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    df_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_gw, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_free<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_chr, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m4_gw, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
  
    fallback_df <- data.table(
      comparison = c("free", "constrained"),
      AIC = c(aic_free, aic_constr),
      BIC = c(bic_free, bic_constr),
      df  = c(df_free, df_constr),
      nobs = c(nobs_free, nobs_constr)
    )
    fwrite(fallback_df, out_path)
    message("lavTestLRT failed; wrote AIC/BIC fallback to: ", out_path)
  }
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m4_chr, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m4_chr, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_chr, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_chr)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_chr))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)

  # one model per chrom
  for(c in 1:22) {
    
    data <- filter(table_10kb_g, chrom==c) %>%
      dplyr::select(., avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
    n <- ncol(data)
    
    cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
    colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
    
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
        cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
        p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      }
    }
    
    combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        if (i > j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
        } else if (i < j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
        }
      }
    }
    combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
    rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)
    fwrite(combined_mat, paste("real_data_maps/pearson_chr", c, "_", m, "_10kb.csv", sep=""),
           row.names=T, quote=F)
  
    model_1 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
    "
    
    m1_fit <- sem(model_1,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m1_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_2 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    "
    
    m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m2_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_3 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m3_fit <- sem(model_3,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m3_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_fit)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_fit))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    model_4 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m4_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m4_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_fit)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_fit))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m3_fit, m4_fit),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_DAG4_10kb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  }
}

df_100kb <- scaled_del_sites %>% filter(., scale==1e5) %>% 
                                left_join(., human_maps_100kb,
                                                       by=c("chrom",
                                                       "chromStart",
                                                       "chromEnd",
                                                       "constrained_model"))

# 100 kb
for(m in unique(df_100kb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("100kb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_100kb <- filter(df_100kb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_100kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_100kb$avg_pi)
  
  # replace prop_del_sites by its weighted measure
  if(any(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_100kb$scaled_del_sites_masked) 
  } else {
    tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_100kb$scaled_del_sites_masked) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_100kb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_100kb <- left_join(tbl_100kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                            "chromStart", 
                                            "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_100kb <- left_join(tbl_100kb, rec_latent_100kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_100kb <- left_join(tbl_100kb, mut_latent_100kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                     "chromStart", 
                                                     "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_100kb <- filter(tbl_100kb, coverage >= 0.5)
  names(tbl_100kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")
  
  table_100kb_g <- add_genome_offsets_and_midpoint(tbl_100kb, chrom_lengths=NULL)
  
  data <- dplyr::select(table_100kb_g, avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
  n <- ncol(data)
  
  cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
  colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
      cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
      p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
    }
  }
  
  combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      if (i > j) {
        combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
      } else if (i < j) {
        combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
      }
    }
  }
  combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
  rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)
  fwrite(combined_mat, "real_data_maps/pearson_gw_100kb.csv", row.names=T, quote=F)

  dt <- copy(table_100kb_g) %>%
        arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
        as.data.table()
  setDT(dt)
  
  # model 1
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut", label = "c1", start = 0.25),
      list(p = "B",       label = "c2", start = 0.5)
    ),
    B = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut", label = "c3", start = -0.25)
    )
  )

  covs <- list()
  
  defined <- c(
    direct_mut_pi   = "c1",            # avg_mut -> avg_pi (direct)
    indirect_mut_pi = "c3*c2",         # avg_mut -> B -> avg_pi (indirect)
    total_mut_pi    = "c1 + c3*c2",    # total effect of avg_mut on avg_pi
    direct_B_pi     = "c2"             # direct effect of B on avg_pi
  )
  
  model1_constrained <- make_lavaan_model(edges,
                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,
                                          groups = 22,
                                          free_by = "groups",
                                          label_prefix = "x")
  
  m1_gw <- sem(model1_constrained,
                data       = dt,         
                estimator  = "MLR",              
                missing    = "fiml",             
                meanstructure = FALSE,            
                std.ov     = TRUE,
                fixed.x    = FALSE,
                optim.method = "nlminb",         ,
                group="chrom",
                group.equal="regressions",
                control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  summary(m1_gw, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
  inspect(m1_gw, "coef")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_100kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_100kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_fitmeasures_100kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  m1_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,  
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  summary(m1_chr, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
  inspect(m1_chr, "coef")
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m1_gw, m1_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )

    p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
    colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
    
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
        cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
        p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      }
    }
    
    combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        if (i > j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
        } else if (i < j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
        }
        # Diagonal remains NA
      }
    }

    rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)

    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m1_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_2 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    "
    
    m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m2_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_3 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m3_fit <- sem(model_3,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m3_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_fit)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_fit))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    model_4 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,
               optim.method = "nlminb",    
               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m4_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m4_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_fit)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_fit))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_100kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m3_fit, m4_fit),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_DAG4_100kb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  }
}


df_1Mb <- scaled_del_sites %>% filter(., scale==1e6) %>% 
                                left_join(., human_maps_1Mb,
                                                       by=c("chrom",
                                                       "chromStart",
                                                       "chromEnd",
                                                       "constrained_model"))
# 1 Mb
for(m in unique(df_1Mb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("1Mb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_1Mb <- filter(df_1Mb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_1Mb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_1Mb$avg_pi)
  
  # replace prop_del_sites by its weighted measure
  if(any(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_1Mb$scaled_del_sites_masked) 
  } else {
    tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_1Mb$scaled_del_sites_masked) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_1Mb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_1Mb <- left_join(tbl_1Mb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                            "chromStart", 
                                            "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_1Mb <- left_join(tbl_1Mb, rec_latent_1Mb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_1Mb <- left_join(tbl_1Mb, mut_latent_1Mb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                     "chromStart", 
                                                     "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_1Mb <- filter(tbl_1Mb, coverage >= 0.25)
  names(tbl_1Mb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")
  
  table_1Mb_g <- add_genome_offsets_and_midpoint(tbl_1Mb, chrom_lengths=NULL)
  
  data <- dplyr::select(table_1Mb_g, avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
  n <- ncol(data)
  
  cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
  colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
      cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
      p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
    }
  }
  
  combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      if (i > j) {
        combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
      } else if (i < j) {
        combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
      }
    }
  }
  combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
  rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)
  fwrite(combined_mat, "real_data_maps/pearson_gw_1Mb.csv", row.names=T, quote=F)

  dt <- copy(table_1Mb_g) %>%
        arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
        as.data.table()
  setDT(dt)
  
  # model 1
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut", label = "c1", start = 0.25),
      list(p = "B",       label = "c2", start = 0.5)
    ),
    B = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut", label = "c3", start = -0.25)
    )
  )

  covs <- list()
  
  defined <- c(
    direct_mut_pi   = "c1",            # avg_mut -> avg_pi (direct)
    indirect_mut_pi = "c3*c2",         # avg_mut -> B -> avg_pi (indirect)
    total_mut_pi    = "c1 + c3*c2",    # total effect of avg_mut on avg_pi
    direct_B_pi     = "c2"             # direct effect of B on avg_pi
  )
  
  model1_constrained <- make_lavaan_model(edges,
                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,
                                          groups = 22,
                                          free_by = "groups",
                                          label_prefix = "x")
  
  m1_gw <- sem(model1_constrained,
                data       = dt,         
                estimator  = "MLR",              
                missing    = "fiml",             
                meanstructure = FALSE,            
                std.ov     = TRUE,
                fixed.x    = FALSE,
                optim.method = "nlminb",         ,
                group="chrom",
                group.equal="regressions",
                control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  summary(m1_gw, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
  inspect(m1_gw, "coef")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  m1_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,  
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  summary(m1_chr, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
  inspect(m1_chr, "coef")
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m1_gw, m1_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG1_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {
    # lavTestLRT returns a matrix/data.frame; coerce to data.table for fwrite
    df <- as.data.table(lrt_res, keep.rownames = "comparison")
    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "comparison")
    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
      xn <- as.numeric(x)
      if (all(is.na(xn)) && is.character(x)) return(x) else return(xn)
    }), .SDcols = num_cols]
    fwrite(df, out_path)
    message("Wrote lavTestLRT results to: ", out_path)
  } else {
    # Fallback: AIC/BIC and sample-size-adjusted comparisons
    aic_free <- AIC(m1_chr); aic_constr <- AIC(m1_gw)
    bic_free <- BIC(m1_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m1_gw)
    df_free  <- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m1_chr, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    df_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m1_gw, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_free<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m1_chr, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m1_gw, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
  
    fallback_df <- data.table(
      comparison = c("free", "constrained"),
      AIC = c(aic_free, aic_constr),
      BIC = c(bic_free, bic_constr),
      df  = c(df_free, df_constr),
      nobs = c(nobs_free, nobs_constr)
    )
    fwrite(fallback_df, out_path)
    message("lavTestLRT failed; wrote AIC/BIC fallback to: ", out_path)
  }
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1_chr, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1_chr, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_chr, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1_chr)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1_chr))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # model 2
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(

                 missing    = "fiml",
                 fixed.x = FALSE,
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,               
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="regressions",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m2_gw, "r2"))),

  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2_gw)),

  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific

  )
  
  m2_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,    
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m2_gw, m2_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {

    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes

    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {

  } else {

    bic_free <- BIC(m2_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m2_gw)

         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  model_free_with_group_defs <- paste0(model_free_with_group_defs, "\n", "avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites")

  m3_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,    
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m3_gw, m3_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("lavTestLRT failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {
    # lavTestLRT returns a matrix/data.frame; coerce to data.table for fwrite
    df <- as.data.table(lrt_res, keep.rownames = "comparison")
    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "comparison")
    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
      xn <- as.numeric(x)
      if (all(is.na(xn)) && is.character(x)) return(x) else return(xn)
    }), .SDcols = num_cols]
    fwrite(df, out_path)
    message("Wrote lavTestLRT results to: ", out_path)
  } else {
    # Fallback: AIC/BIC and sample-size-adjusted comparisons
    aic_free <- AIC(m3_chr); aic_constr <- AIC(m3_gw)
    bic_free <- BIC(m3_chr); bic_constr <- BIC(m3_gw)
    df_free  <- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_chr, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    df_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_gw, "df"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_free<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_chr, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
    nobs_constr<- tryCatch(fitMeasures(m3_gw, "nobs"), error = function(e) NA)
  
    fallback_df <- data.table(
      comparison = c("free", "constrained"),
      AIC = c(aic_free, aic_constr),
      BIC = c(bic_free, bic_constr),
      df  = c(df_free, df_constr),
      nobs = c(nobs_free, nobs_constr)
    )
    fwrite(fallback_df, out_path)
    message("lavTestLRT failed; wrote AIC/BIC fallback to: ", out_path)
  }
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3_chr, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3_chr, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3_chr, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_genomewide_",

  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_chr)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_chr))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # model 4
  edges <- list(
    avg_pi = list(
      list(p = "avg_mut",       label = "c1", start = 0.25),

    prop_del_sites = list()
  )
  
  # Covariances
  covs <- list(
    c("avg_mut", "prop_del_sites")
  )
  
  # Defined combinations (named character vector)
  defined <- c(

                                          covs = covs,
                                          defined = defined,

  fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  # build a per_group_map that marks every lhs~rhs as group-specific
  per_group_map <- character()
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    for (r in edges[[lhs]]) {
      rhs <- if (is.list(r)) r$p else r
      per_group_map[paste0(lhs, "~", rhs)] <- "groups"
    }
  }
  
  model_free_with_group_defs <- make_lavaan_model_free_with_grouped_defined(
    edges = edges, covs = covs, defined = defined,
    groups = 22, per_group_map = per_group_map, label_prefix = "x"
  )

  m4_chr <- sem(model_free_with_group_defs,
                 data       = dt,         
                 estimator  = "MLR",              
                 missing    = "fiml",             
                 meanstructure = FALSE,            
                 std.ov     = TRUE,    
                 fixed.x    = FALSE,
                 optim.method = "nlminb",         
                 group="chrom",
                 group.equal="none",
                 control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  lrt_res <- tryCatch(
    lavTestLRT(m4_gw, m4_chr, method = "satorra.bentler.2001"),

  out_path <- paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG4_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_latents_", m, ".csv")

  if (!is.null(lrt_res)) {
    # lavTestLRT returns a matrix/data.frame; coerce to data.table for fwrite
    df <- as.data.table(lrt_res, keep.rownames = "comparison")
    # ensure numeric columns stay numeric; some lavTestLRT variants add attributes
    num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "comparison")
    df[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {

    data <- filter(table_1Mb_g, chrom==c) %>%
      dplyr::select(., avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
    n <- ncol(data)
    
    cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
    colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
    colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
    
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
        cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
        p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      }
    }
    
    combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (j in 1:n) {
        if (i > j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
        } else if (i < j) {
          combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
        }
        # Diagonal remains NA
      }
    }
    
    combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
    rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)

    model_1 <- "

    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B

    model_2 <- "

    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    "
    
    m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",

               std.ov     = TRUE,

               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_1Mb_chr",

           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m2_fit, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_3 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m3_fit <- sem(model_3,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",              
               missing    = "fiml",             
               meanstructure = FALSE,            
               std.ov     = TRUE,     
               fixed.x    = TRUE,

               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))

           col.names=F)
    
    model_4 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
               data=filter(dt, chrom==c),
               estimator  = "MLR",

               control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m4_fit, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m4_fit, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG4_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_fit, ci=T),

# bootstrapping chr 22 to test if the high R^2 is due to sampling low drift-variance windows
nboot <- 1e3
c22 <- filter(dt, chrom==c)
c22_r2_m1 <- numeric(length=nboot)
c22_r2_m2 <- numeric(length=nboot)
c22_r2_m3 <- numeric(length=nboot)
c22_r2_m4 <- numeric(length=nboot)

for(b in 1:1000) {
  
  cat(paste("boot", b, "\n"))
  
  c22_boot <- c22 %>% dplyr::slice_sample(prop=1, replace=TRUE)
  
  m1_fit <- sem(model_1,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m1[b] <- inspect(m1_fit, "r2")[1]
  
  m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m2[b] <- inspect(m2_fit, "r2")[1]
  
  m3_fit <- sem(model_3,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m3[b] <- inspect(m3_fit, "r2")[1]

  m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
             data=c22_boot,
             estimator  = "MLR",              
             missing    = "fiml",             
             meanstructure = FALSE,            
             std.ov     = TRUE,     
             fixed.x    = FALSE,
             optim.method = "nlminb",    
             control    = list(trace = 0, rel.tol = 1e-8, iter.max = 1000))
  
  c22_r2_m4[b] <- inspect(m4_fit, "r2")[1]
}
```

Simple correlations (latent constructs for B, mu, r)

```{r, simple-pearson, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# 10kb
pearson_10kb_models <- list(length=2)
const_models <- c("phastcons", "func_split_exons")
for(i in 1:length(const_models)) {
  
  m <- const_models[i]
  pearson_10kb <- list(length=22)
  
  for(c in 1:22) {
    
    tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/pearson_chr", c, "_", m, "_10kb.csv", sep=""))
    
    # variable names (excluding the row label column)
    var_names <- setdiff(names(tmp), "V1")
    
    # Long form with row/col indices
    long <- tmp %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -V1,
        names_to = "variable2",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(variable1 = V1) %>%
      filter(variable1 != variable2) %>%
      mutate(
        i = match(variable1, var_names),  # row index
        j = match(variable2, var_names),  # column index
        pair_key = paste(pmin(variable1, variable2), pmax(variable1, variable2), sep = "|")
      )
    
    # Lower triangle: correlations (i > j)
    corr_long <- long %>%
      filter(i > j, !is.na(value)) %>%
      transmute(
        pair_key,
        var1 = pmin(variable1, variable2),
        var2 = pmax(variable1, variable2),
        correlation = as.numeric(value)
      )
    
    # Upper triangle: p-values (i < j)
    pval_long <- long %>%
      filter(i < j, !is.na(value)) %>%
      transmute(
        pair_key,
        pvalue = as.numeric(value)
      )
    
    # Join correlations and p-values on the unordered pair key
    flat_matrix <- corr_long %>%
      left_join(pval_long, by = "pair_key") %>%
      arrange(., var1, var2)
        
    flat_matrix$chrom <- c
    pearson_10kb[[c]] <- flat_matrix
  }

pearson_10kb_models <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, pearson_10kb_models)

# 100kb
pearson_100kb_models <- list(length=2)
const_models <- c("phastcons", "func_split_exons")
for(i in 1:length(const_models)) {
  
  m <- const_models[i]
  pearson_100kb <- list(length=22)
  
  for(c in 1:22) {
    
    tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/pearson_chr", c, "_", m, "_100kb.csv", sep=""))
    
    # variable names (excluding the row label column)
    var_names <- setdiff(names(tmp), "V1")
    
    # Long form with row/col indices
    long <- tmp %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -V1,
        names_to = "variable2",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(variable1 = V1) %>%
      filter(variable1 != variable2) %>%
      mutate(
        i = match(variable1, var_names),  # row index
        j = match(variable2, var_names),  # column index
        pair_key = paste(pmin(variable1, variable2), pmax(variable1, variable2), sep = "|")
      )
    
    # Lower triangle: correlations (i > j)
    corr_long <- long %>%
      filter(i > j, !is.na(value)) %>%
      transmute(
        pair_key,
        var1 = pmin(variable1, variable2),
        var2 = pmax(variable1, variable2),
        correlation = as.numeric(value)
      )
    
    # Upper triangle: p-values (i < j)
    pval_long <- long %>%
      filter(i < j, !is.na(value)) %>%
      transmute(
        pair_key,
        pvalue = as.numeric(value)
      )
    
    # Join correlations and p-values on the unordered pair key
    flat_matrix <- corr_long %>%
      left_join(pval_long, by = "pair_key") %>%
      arrange(., var1, var2)
        
    flat_matrix$chrom <- c
    pearson_100kb[[c]] <- flat_matrix
  }
  
  pearson_100kb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, pearson_100kb)
  pearson_100kb$constrained_model <- m
  
  pearson_100kb_models[[i]] <- pearson_100kb
}
```
