```{r, simple-pearson-raw-mut, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

## reload
human_maps_10kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_10kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))

human_maps_100kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_100kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                    filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                    dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))

human_maps_1Mb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_1Mb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))

# 10kb
pearson_10kb <- list(length=length(unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) *
                     length(unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) *
                     22)
idx <- 1
for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) {
    for(c in 1:22) {
    
      data <- filter(human_maps_10kb, mut_map==u, constrained_model==m, chrom==c,
                     coverage >= 0.75, demo=="equilibrium") %>%
        dplyr::select(., avg_pi, prop_del_sites, B, avg_rec, avg_mut)
      n <- ncol(data)
      
      cor_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
      p_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
      colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(data)
      colnames(p_mat) <- rownames(p_mat) <- colnames(data)
      
      for (i in 1:n) {
        for (j in 1:n) {
          test <- cor.test(data[[i]], data[[j]], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
          cor_mat[i, j] <- test$estimate
          p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
        }
      }
      
      combined_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
      for (i in 1:n) {
        for (j in 1:n) {
          if (i > j) {
            combined_mat[i, j] <- round(cor_mat[i, j], 4)
          } else if (i < j) {
            combined_mat[i, j] <- signif(p_mat[i, j], 3)
          }
        }
      }
      
      combined_mat <- setDT(as.data.frame(combined_mat))
      rownames(combined_mat) <- colnames(combined_mat) <- colnames(data)
      
      var_names <- names(combined_mat)
      combined_mat$V1 <- rownames(combined_mat)
      
      long <- combined_mat %>%
        pivot_longer(
          cols = -V1,
          names_to = "variable2",
          values_to = "value"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::rename(variable1 = V1) %>%
        filter(variable1 != variable2) %>%
        mutate(
          i = match(variable1, var_names),  # row index
          j = match(variable2, var_names),  # column index
          pair_key = paste(pmin(variable1, variable2), pmax(variable1, variable2), sep = "|")
        )
      
      corr_long <- long %>%
        filter(i > j, !is.na(value)) %>%
        transmute(
          pair_key,
          var1 = pmin(variable1, variable2),
          var2 = pmax(variable1, variable2),
          correlation = as.numeric(value)
        )
      
      pval_long <- long %>%
        filter(i < j, !is.na(value)) %>%
        transmute(
          pair_key,
          pvalue = as.numeric(value)
        )
      
      flat_matrix <- corr_long %>%
        left_join(pval_long, by = "pair_key") %>%
        arrange(., var1, var2)
          
      flat_matrix$chrom <- c
      flat_matrix$constrained_model <- m
      flat_matrix$mut_map <- u
      
      pearson_10kb[[idx]] <- flat_matrix
      idx <- idx + 1
    }
  }
}
```

```{r SEM-human-fitmeasures, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
p2 <- ggplot(data=filter(chr_LRT_latent, scale==1e5), 
               aes(x=chrom, 
                   y=-log10(pvalue))) +
        geom_point(size=3) +

        facet_wrap(~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
        scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:22) +
        labs(title=NULL, x=NULL, y="-log10(p-value)") +
        theme(strip.text.x=element_blank(),   
              axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
              axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
              axis.text.x=element_blank())

p3 <- ggplot(data=filter(chr_LRT_latent, scale==1e6), 
               aes(x=chrom, 
                   y=-log10(pvalue))) +
        geom_point(size=3) +
        geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05/bonferroni), linetype="dashed", color="darkgrey") +
        facet_wrap(~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
        scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:22) +
        labs(title=NULL, x="Chromosome", y="-log10(p-value)") +
        theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),      
              strip.text.x=element_blank(),   
              axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
              axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
              axis.text.x=element_text(size=16))

pc <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol=1)
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_LRT_DAGs3vs4.pdf", pc, base_height=10, base_width=20)
```

```{r SEM-chr-features, evale=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
setDT(tbl)
setDT(chr_r2_dags)
tab <- left_join(df, chr_r2_dags, by=c("chrom", "DAG", "constrained_model", "scale"))
#tab <- chr_r2_dags[tbl, on=c("chrom","constrained_model")]

lm_list <- list(length=length(unique(tab$constrained_model)) *
                       length(unique(tab$scale)) *
                       length(unique(tab$DAG)))
c <- 1
for(const in unique(tab$constrained_model)) {
  for(scal in unique(tab$scale)) {
    for(dag in unique(tab$DAG)) {
    
      df_transf <- filter(tab, constrained_model==const, scale==scal, DAG==dag) %>%
        dplyr::select(., c(avg_pi, mut_latent_log, rec_latent_log, prop_del_sites, GC)) 
    
      df_transf <- apply(df_transf, 2, std_by_sd) %>% as.data.frame()
      names(df_transf)[3] <- "avg_mut"
      names(df_transf)[4] <- "avg_rec"
      
      meta_lm <- lm(data=df_transf,
                    formula=avg_pi ~ GC + prop_del_sites + avg_mut + avg_rec)
      
      summ <- summary(meta_lm)
      
      coefs_df <- as.data.frame(summ$coefficients)
      coefs_df$term <- rownames(coefs_df)
      rownames(coefs_df) <- NULL
      names(coefs_df)[4] <- "p-value"
      
      coefs_df$constrained_model <- const
      coefs_df$scale <- scal
      coefs_df$DAG <- dag
      coefs_df$r2_lm <- summ$r.squared
      coefs_df$r2_adj_lm <- summ$adj.r.squared
  
      lm_list[[c]] <- coefs_df %>% dplyr::select(., c("term", "Estimate", "p-value",
                                                      "constrained_model", "scale", "DAG", 
                                                      "r2_lm", "r2_adj_lm")) %>%
                                   filter(., term!="(Intercept)")
      c <- c + 1
      #fwrite(setDT(coefs_df), paste("real_data_maps/lm_r2pi_", const, "_", scal, ".csv", sep=""))
    }
  }
}

      scale_x_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("brown1", "cyan3"), name="DAG") +
      labs(title="Does % deleterious sites predict chr R^2?",
           x="% Del. Sites", y=expression(R^2)) +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_R2_delsites.svg", s, 
          base_height=10, base_width=20)
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_R2_delsites.pdf", s, 
          base_height=10, base_width=20)
```

## Path Models with simulated pi

Here we use simulated pi (mutational variance)

10 kb

```{r SEM-human-maps-10kb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_10kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_10kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))
  
for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
  Sys.time()
  
  cat(paste("fitting SEM(s) -- ", u, sep=""))
  cat("\n")

  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
      
      tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb,
                         coverage >= 0.75,
                         mut_map==u,
                         constrained_model==m,
                         demo==d) %>%
                         dplyr::select(., -starts_with("bin_")) 
      
      tbl_10kb_log <- cbind.data.frame(tbl_10kb[,1:3],
                        apply(tbl_10kb[,4:(ncol(tbl_10kb)-4)], 2, log))
      
      # because of 0's
      if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
        tbl_10kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
      } else {
        tbl_10kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
      }
      
      # one model per chrom
      for(c in 1:22) {
    
        model_1 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
        "
        
        m1_fit <- sem(model_1,
                   data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   meanstructure=T,
                   estimator="MLR",              
                   missing="fiml",
                   optim.method = "nlminb",   
                   control=list(trace=0, rel.tol=1e-8, iter.max=1000))
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1_fit, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m1_fit, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m1_fit, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_params_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_2 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        "
        
        m2_fit <- sem(model_2,
                   data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   meanstructure=T,
                   estimator="MLR",              
                   missing="fiml",
                   optim.method = "nlminb",   
                   control=list(trace=0, rel.tol=1e-8, iter.max=1000))
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2_fit, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m2_fit, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_r2_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m2_fit, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_params_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_3 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites

        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
        rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
        "

        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3_fit)),
                                as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3_fit))),
```

```{r SEM-human-maps-1Mb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# 1Mb scale can find some issues on the way due to sample size, this function helps
summarize_lrt <- function(lrt) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(lrt), nrow(lrt) == 2)

  model_names <- rownames(lrt)
  df_vals     <- lrt$Df
  chisq_vals  <- lrt$Chisq

  idx_constrained    <- which.max(df_vals)   # higher df = more constrained
  idx_unconstrained  <- which.min(df_vals)   # lower df = less constrained

  df_diff     <- abs(df_vals[idx_constrained] - df_vals[idx_unconstrained])
  chisq_diff  <- abs(chisq_vals[idx_constrained] - chisq_vals[idx_unconstrained])
  p_value     <- pchisq(chisq_diff, df = df_diff, lower.tail = FALSE)

  method <- attr(lrt, "method")
  if (is.null(method)) method <- "default"

  data.frame(
    model_constrained   = model_names[idx_constrained],
    model_unconstrained = model_names[idx_unconstrained],
    df_constrained      = df_vals[idx_constrained],
    df_unconstrained    = df_vals[idx_unconstrained],
    df_diff             = df_diff,
    chisq_constrained   = chisq_vals[idx_constrained],
    chisq_unconstrained = chisq_vals[idx_unconstrained],
    chisq_diff          = chisq_diff,
    p_value        = p_value, # to keep format consisten with lavaan method
    method              = method,
    row.names           = NULL
  )
}

        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
        rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
        "
        
        m4_fit <- sem(model_4,
                   data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   meanstructure=T,
                   estimator="MLR",              
                   missing="fiml",
                   optim.method = "nlminb",   
                   control=list(trace=0, rel.tol=1e-8, iter.max=1000))
        
        converged_4 <- tryCatch(lavInspect(m4_fit, "converged"), error = function(e) NA)
        
        if(isTRUE(converged_4)) {
        
          fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m4_fit, "r2")),
                                  as.numeric(inspect(m4_fit, "r2"))), 
                 paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG34_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                       c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
                 col.names=F)
      
          fwrite(parameterestimates(m4_fit, ci=T), 
                 paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG4_params_1Mb_chr", 
                       c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m4_fit)),
                                  as.numeric(fitMeasures(m4_fit))), 
                paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG4_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                       c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
                col.names=F)
    
            if(isTRUE(converged_3)) {
              lrt_result <- tryCatch(
                lavTestLRT(m3_fit, m4_fit),
                error = function(e1) {
                  message("Default LRT failed, trying Satorra–Bentler...")
                  tryCatch(
                    lavTestLRT(m3_fit, m4_fit, method = "satorra.bentler.2010"),
                    error = function(e2) {
                      message("Satorra–Bentler failed, trying scaled–shifted...")
                      lavTestLRT(m3_fit, m4_fit, method = "standard")
                    }
                  )
                }
              )
              
              tab <- summarize_lrt(lrt_result)
              names(tab)[9] <- "Pr(>Chisq)"
      
              fwrite(tab, paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_DAG4_1Mb_chr",
                         c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r SEM-human-params, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# per chromosome SEM models
## 10 kb
chr_params_10kb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 3:4) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_10kb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_10kb$scale <- 1e+4

## 100 kb
chr_params_100kb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 3:4) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_100kb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_100kb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_100kb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_100kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_100kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_100kb$scale <- 1e+5

## 1 Mb
chr_params_1Mb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 3:4) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_1Mb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_1Mb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_1Mb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          
          fname <- file.path(paste0("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_1Mb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          if (file.exists(fname)) {
            tmp <- fread(fname)
            
            tmp$chrom <- c
            tmp$DAG <- dag
            tmp$mut_map <- u
            tmp$constrained_model <- m
            tmp$demo <- d
            
            chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
          }
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_1Mb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_1Mb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_1Mb$scale <- 1e+6

chr_params <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb,
                               chr_params_100kb,
                               chr_params_1Mb)  %>%
              filter(., pvalue < 0.05 / 22 / 3) %>%
              filter(., op=="~" | op==":=") 

chr_params_ext <- left_join(chr_params, 
                            chr_fitmeasures,
                            by=c("chrom", "DAG", "mut_map",
                                 "constrained_model", "demo", "scale"))

names(chr_params_ext)[8] <- "pvalue_est"
names(chr_params_ext)[21] <- "pvalue_DAG"

# ratios of PCs from B and Mu to Pi
chr_wide <- chr_params_ext %>% dplyr::select(., -c(op, label, se, z, pvalue_est, pvalue_DAG,
                             ci.lower, ci.upper)) %>%
         filter(., demo=="equilibrium", lhs=="pi_sim_tot") %>% 
         filter(., rhs=="avg_mut" | rhs=="B") %>%
         pivot_wider(values_from="est", names_from="rhs")

chr_wide$ratio_B_u <- chr_wide$B / chr_wide$avg_mut
```
